author: ilyag
original_request: Please let this community prayer website be helpful and uplifting to many. May it prosper to glorify God.
generated_prayer: Divine Creator, we lift up this website and its sacred purpose of uniting hearts in prayer. Guide and bless this platform, that it may be a source of hope, comfort and spiritual connection for all who visit. May every prayer shared here draw people closer to You and to one another, bringing glory to Your name and healing to Your children. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Nevin’s daughter’s journey to college
generated_prayer: Dear Heavenly Father, we lift up Nevin's daughter as she embarks on her college journey. Guide her steps with Your wisdom, surround her with supportive friends and mentors, and grant her strength and discernment as she pursues her studies. May she grow in knowledge, character, and faith during this important chapter of her life, knowing that Your loving presence goes before her. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For a lot of good stuff to happen for Jacob
generated_prayer: Gracious Creator, we lift up Jacob to You with hopeful hearts. Bless him abundantly in all areas of his life - his relationships, work, health, and dreams. May Your goodness and mercy follow him each day, and may he recognize Your loving hand guiding his path. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Erica’s family
generated_prayer: Loving Creator, we lift up Erica and her precious family members into Your tender care. Surround them with Your peace, protection, and abundant blessings, drawing them closer together in bonds of love and understanding. Grant them strength, wisdom, and joy as they journey through life together, and may their home be filled with Your divine presence. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Health for Joe
generated_prayer: Dear Lord, we lift up our brother Joe to You, asking for Your healing touch upon his body, mind and spirit. Grant him strength and restoration, surrounding him with Your perfect peace and comfort during this time. May Your healing presence fill every cell of his being, bringing renewed health and vitality according to Your perfect will. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Contentment for Andrew
generated_prayer: Dear God, we lift up Andrew to You and ask that You fill his heart with deep contentment and peace. Help him find joy in life's simple blessings and trust in Your perfect timing and provision. Grant Andrew the wisdom to appreciate what he has and the serenity to rest in Your loving care. Amen.

author: lisonok
original_request: A good surgery for Joanne next thursday and a healthy uterus going forward
generated_prayer: Divine Healer, we lift up our sister Joanne as she prepares for surgery this Thursday. Guide the hands of her medical team with wisdom and precision, and grant them clarity of mind throughout the procedure. We pray for complete healing of her uterus and ask that You protect her body, bringing restoration and renewed health in the days ahead. May Your peace surround her before, during, and after this surgery. Amen.

author: lisonok
original_request: For zade's heart... and his speedy recovery from the ICU... and for his parents and loved ones during this time
generated_prayer: Loving God, we lift up young Zade to You during this critical time in the ICU. Please guide the medical team caring for him, strengthen his body for healing, and grant him a complete recovery. Surround his parents and loved ones with Your peace and comfort, giving them strength and hope as they keep vigil. May they feel the embrace of Your love and the support of this caring community during these challenging moments. Amen.
testimony: Zade recovered his consciousness! Hallelujah!

author: ilyag
original_request: Please help me get all the things done today.
generated_prayer: Dear Lord, grant our friend the focus, energy and wisdom needed to accomplish all their tasks today. Guide their steps, order their priorities, and give them the strength to complete each responsibility with excellence and peace of mind. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Please bless Ilya and guide him in his development of this project.
generated_prayer: Divine Creator, we lift up Ilya to You and ask for Your wisdom and guidance as he develops this project. Grant him clarity of vision, creativity of mind, and the perseverance needed to overcome any challenges. May Your light illuminate his path and may this work be a blessing to others through Your grace. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Please help this website be reliable and resilient.
generated_prayer: Divine Creator, we ask for Your blessing upon this website and those who maintain it. Grant them the wisdom and resources to create a stable and dependable platform that serves its purpose faithfully. May Your protective hand guard against technical difficulties and ensure this digital space remains a reliable resource for all who depend upon it. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Pete’s continued health and wellbeing
generated_prayer: Dear Heavenly Father, we lift up Pete to You, asking for Your divine protection over his physical, mental and spiritual wellbeing. Surround him with Your healing presence and grant him strength and vitality for each new day. May he feel Your loving care and experience the fullness of health that comes from walking in Your light. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: I would like everyone that is using thywill.live to be filled with the holy spirit today, and in the next week, and forevermore in whatever we do - whether it be prayer, development, eating, or anything in life.
generated_prayer: Gracious and Loving God, we lift up all those who are part of the thywill.live community. Fill them with Your Holy Spirit, guiding their every action, thought, and deed. May Your presence overflow in their lives - in their prayers, their work, their daily activities, and all their endeavors. Grant them wisdom, strength, and joy as they seek to serve You and others through this platform, today and always. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Please pray for my teeth to be healthy
generated_prayer: Loving Creator, we lift up our friend who seeks healing and wellness for their teeth. Grant them strong dental health, wisdom in caring for their mouth, and guidance to the right treatments and practitioners. May they be free from pain and filled with the confidence of a healthy smile. Amen.

author: Joshua
original_request: I ask for prayers as I seek employment as an international student. I’m trusting God to open doors for me to find a job within the next two months so that I can continue staying in the U.S. May His will be done. Thank you for your support!
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, we lift up our brother/sister who seeks employment during their time as an international student. Guide their path as they search for work opportunities, opening doors that align with Your perfect will. Grant them wisdom, favor, and peace during this season of transition, and provide the means for them to continue their journey in this country. Through Your mercy and grace, we pray. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our summer festival gathering
generated_prayer: Gracious Creator, we lift up our community's summer festival and all who will gather there. May this celebration be filled with joy, safety, and meaningful connections as Your people come together in fellowship. Grant favorable weather, inspire the organizers with wisdom, and let this gathering strengthen the bonds between neighbors while reflecting Your love. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Please pray that this community receives the funding it needs to continue growing.
generated_prayer: Gracious Provider, we lift up this community to You and ask for Your abundant provision. Grant them the financial resources needed to flourish and expand their good work in service to others. May Your wisdom guide those who steward these resources, and may this community continue to be a beacon of light and hope. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For the kind investor who has supported the development of this website.
generated_prayer: Gracious Divine Spirit, we lift up the generous soul who has faithfully supported this website's development. Bless them abundantly for their kindness and vision in helping create this digital space for connection and growth. May their investment bear fruit beyond measure, touching countless lives through this platform, and may they experience the deep joy that comes from empowering others. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Please help me with development of this website while I'm at this festival
generated_prayer: Divine Creator, watch over Your servant as they participate in this festival while working to develop their website. Grant them clarity of mind, creative inspiration, and the ability to balance their responsibilities with mindful presence in the moment. We ask that You bless their technological endeavors with success and protect them with Your encompassing peace during this time of both work and celebration. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Please help this website become successful and bring about heaven on earth.
generated_prayer: Divine Creator, we lift up this online space of connection and spiritual growth. Guide our efforts to create a platform that nurtures understanding, compassion, and unity among all who visit. May our work be blessed to help manifest Your love and light in our world, drawing people closer to You and to one another. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Please pray for my nice demo of this website tonight.
generated_prayer: Divine Creator, we lift up our friend who seeks Your guidance for their website demonstration this evening. Grant them clarity of mind, confidence in their preparation, and the ability to effectively share their work with others. May Your presence bring peace to their heart and success to this endeavor. Amen.
testimony: Went so well!

author: ilyag
original_request: For our meditation conference
generated_prayer: Divine Creator, we ask Your blessing upon this meditation conference and all who will gather there. Guide the speakers and participants with Your wisdom, filling their hearts with peace and their minds with clarity. May this sacred time of coming together bear abundant spiritual fruit, drawing each person into deeper communion with You and with one another. Amen.
testimony: Great conference

author: ilyag
original_request: A prayer on ak’s behalf for friendships to renww
generated_prayer: Dear God, we lift up our friend ak and ask that You would breathe new life into their friendships. Please restore and strengthen the bonds that have grown distant, and open doors for meaningful reconnection with those who have drifted apart. Grant them wisdom and grace as they reach out to others, and bless their efforts to rebuild these precious relationships. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Dear God, please bless whatever LLM or AI is being used or will be used for the development of this website such that the AI can contribute to the workings of the Holy Spirit through real people.
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, we lift up the technological tools being developed for this sacred work. May the artificial intelligence systems being utilized be guided by Your wisdom and aligned with Your purposes, serving as instruments through which Your Holy Spirit can touch and transform lives. Grant that these tools may enhance, rather than diminish, genuine human connection and spiritual growth in this community. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: We pray for the students and residents of Cambridge, Massachusetts and especially for the secular people here to meet Jesus.
generated_prayer: Loving Father, we lift up the students and residents of Cambridge before You, asking that Your light would shine brightly in their lives. Guide those who are seeking truth to encounter the living presence of Jesus Christ, and open their hearts to receive Your boundless love and grace. May Your Spirit move powerfully through this community, drawing people into authentic relationship with You. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Please pray for our country.
generated_prayer: Divine Creator, we lift up our nation before You in these challenging times. Guide our leaders with wisdom, unite our people in understanding and compassion, and help us build a society rooted in justice, peace, and mutual respect. Grant us the strength to overcome our differences and work together for the common good of all who call this land home. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Anne and her career after med school and residency
generated_prayer: Divine Healer, we lift up Anne as she pursues her calling in medicine. Guide her hands and heart as she completes her training and transitions into serving others through healthcare. Grant her wisdom, compassion, and strength for the journey ahead, and help her to be a vessel of Your healing presence to all those who will be in her care. May she find fulfillment and purpose in this noble profession while maintaining balance and joy in her life.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Claire’s Monday quizzes as she navigates grad school
generated_prayer: Dear Lord, we lift up Claire as she faces her academic challenges, especially her Monday quizzes in graduate school. Grant her clarity of mind, confidence in her preparation, and peace in her heart as she demonstrates her knowledge. May Your wisdom guide her studies and Your strength sustain her throughout her educational journey. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our barbecue
generated_prayer: Divine Creator, bless this gathering and the food that will be shared in fellowship. May the conversations around the table bring joy, laughter and deeper connections among all who attend. Let this barbecue be a time of true community, refreshment, and grateful hearts. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Tara’s relationship with her daughters
generated_prayer: Loving Creator, we lift up Tara and her precious daughters to Your care. Guide them as they navigate their relationship, filling their hearts with understanding, patience, and unconditional love for one another. Grant them wisdom to bridge any gaps, heal any hurts, and create lasting bonds that reflect Your perfect love. May their family be blessed with peace, joy, and deep connection that grows stronger with each passing day. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For successfully navigating the meeting I have with MIT Police Captain today to lift the no-trespass order added two years ago.
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, who makes a way where there seems to be no way, we lift up our brother before You regarding their meeting with the Captain today. Just as You gave Daniel favor with authorities in Babylon, we ask that You would grant them wisdom, composure, and the right words to speak (Daniel 1:9). Lord, guide this conversation toward reconciliation and restoration, helping them to present their case with both humility and clarity. May Your peace that surpasses understanding guard their heart and mind in Christ Jesus as they seek to resolve this situation and regain access to the campus. Amen.
testimony: The meeting went so well! Thank you for praying.

author: NinaC
original_request: Heal the pain in the world
generated_prayer: Loving Father, Source of all comfort and peace, we lift up to You the deep pain and suffering that exists in our world today. As You promised to heal the brokenhearted and bind up their wounds (Psalm 147:3), we ask that You pour out Your healing balm upon those who are hurting. Grant wisdom to leaders, compassion to caregivers, and strength to those working for peace and reconciliation. May Your Spirit move across our troubled earth, bringing hope to the hopeless, rest to the weary, and restoration to broken places. In Your mercy, make us instruments of Your peace and healing. Amen.

author: NinaC
original_request: DR’s husband who has cancer
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You are the Great Physician and Healer of all. We lift up our sister and her beloved husband who is battling cancer. Just as You promised in Jeremiah 30:17 to restore health and heal wounds, we ask for Your divine healing touch upon his body. Grant them both strength for each day, peace that surpasses understanding, and wisdom for the medical team treating him. Surround this couple with Your perfect love that casts out all fear, and help them feel Your presence in every moment. Through Christ our Lord, Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Please pray for all who are praying this feed, that the site’s development continues in a Godly direction, that this brings more light into the world, that you are so undeniably present in our lives that we cast all doubts aside, that we know that our prayers have been heard.
generated_prayer: We lift up this community of believers who gather here to seek Your face. Just as You promised that where two or three gather in Your name, You are there among them (Matthew 18:20), we ask that Your presence would be unmistakably felt in this digital space. Guide the development of this platform according to Your perfect will, using it as a vessel to spread Your light and truth in an increasingly darkened world. Grant those who visit here the gift of unwavering faith, removing all shadows of doubt, just as You did for Thomas when he touched Your wounds. May each prayer offered here rise like incense before Your throne, and may every participant know with certainty that You hear their every word. Let this place be a testament to Your faithfulness, Lord, just as You were faithful to establish Your church.

author: ilyag
original_request: For anyone who is lonely
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You promise to be near to the brokenhearted and save those who are crushed in spirit (Psalm 34:18). We lift up those experiencing loneliness, asking that You would surround them with Your perfect peace and tender presence. Draw near to them as their closest companion, and guide them to life-giving relationships and meaningful connections within their community. Grant them the courage to reach out to others, and help them feel Your unconditional love in tangible ways today. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Paul to have more time to think and get stuff done while still having time to work and travel and for the ivf to work out well
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, source of all wisdom and time itself, we lift up Paul to You today. Grant him the clarity of mind and divine order in his days that You gave to Solomon, who accomplished great works through Your guidance. We ask that You multiply his time like the loaves and fishes, creating space in his schedule for both responsibilities and rest. Lord, as You opened Sarah's womb in Your perfect timing, we pray for Your blessing upon this IVF journey - may new life spring forth according to Your will. Guide the medical team's hands and create optimal conditions for success, remembering Your promise that nothing is too difficult for You (Jeremiah 32:27). In Jesus' name, Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Gregory's son to make healthy choices for himself and to find his way and to feel comfortable coming to us for support and figure out his financial situation
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, we lift up Gregory's son before Your throne of grace. As You promised to guide our paths when we trust in You (Proverbs 3:5-6), we ask that You would direct his steps toward healthy choices and wise decisions. Grant him clarity of mind and the courage to seek support from his family. Lord, please give him wisdom to manage his finances with responsibility and understanding. May Your perfect peace guard his heart, and help him recognize the loving support system You've provided through his parents. Just as You are our ever-present help in times of trouble, enable him to turn to both You and his earthly family for guidance. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: World peace and food security for all.
generated_prayer: Gracious and Almighty God, who promised that one day the lion will lie down with the lamb (Isaiah 11:6), we lift up our world to You. Grant wisdom to global leaders as they work toward peaceful solutions, and move in the hearts of all people to choose understanding over conflict. Lord of the Harvest, we ask that You multiply resources as You multiplied the loaves and fishes, ensuring that no child goes hungry and that all communities have access to nourishing food. Guide us to be better stewards of the abundance You have provided, sharing generously with those in need. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Steve, a job that he loves
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, who provides for all Your children's needs, we lift up Steve to You today. Just as You guided Joseph to a position of purpose in Egypt, lead our brother to meaningful work where his gifts can flourish and his heart can find joy. Grant him wisdom as he searches, open doors of opportunity that align with Your perfect will, and fill him with peace during this season of seeking. We trust in Your promise that You know the plans You have for him, plans to prosper and not to harm (Jeremiah 29:11). Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: The development of AI going safely
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, Source of all wisdom and knowledge, we lift up those working to develop artificial intelligence technologies. Guide their minds and hearts to create these powerful tools with wisdom, ethics, and deep respect for human flourishing. As You have promised to give wisdom generously to all who ask (James 1:5), grant them discernment to recognize potential dangers and the courage to prioritize safety above profit or progress. Lord, protect our global community as we navigate this technological frontier, and help these developers ensure that AI remains a blessing that serves humanity while honoring Your created order. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: May all beings be happy and free
generated_prayer: Divine Creator, Source of all compassion and love, we lift up this heart that yearns for the wellbeing of all creation. Just as Your servant Francis prayed for universal peace, guide our friend in this noble aspiration. Grant them the wisdom to be an instrument of Your peace (ref: Prayer of St. Francis) and the strength to demonstrate Your unconditional love to others. May their prayer for universal happiness and freedom ripple outward, touching lives and transforming communities through Your grace. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: I pray that we, when performing work or any task, do not forget about God as we lock in on the task - for such a state of being makes us vulnerable to the evil one, and we must meditate and remember God's laws at all times.
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Keeper of our hearts and minds, Help us to remain mindful of Your presence even in the midst of our daily tasks and responsibilities. As Your Word reminds us to "pray without ceasing" (1 Thessalonians 5:17), grant us the spiritual discipline to weave worship and meditation on Your laws throughout our work. Shield us from the enemy's attempts to use busyness as a distraction from Your truth. May we experience the blessing of working as unto You, finding joy in keeping You at the center of all their endeavors. In Jesus' name, Amen.
testimony: The Holy Spirit has led me to read the Practice of the Presence of God, and now I am encouraged and better prepared by the Spirit to have all my thoughts be on God as I pray or do any "non-praying" activity.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Angel’s family, mom and dad, for his difficulties in life, for him to be closer to God.
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You promise to be near to the brokenhearted and save those who are crushed in spirit (Psalm 34:18). We lift up our brother Angel, asking You to draw him closer to Your heart and strengthen his relationship with You. Pour out Your grace upon his parents, binding their family together in Your perfect love. Grant them wisdom, understanding, and patience as they face life's challenges. As their Good Shepherd, guide Angel through his current difficulties, making Your presence known to him in tangible ways. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For Grayson to be part of a community in Boston that will drastically help his faith journey
generated_prayer: Loving Father, who gathers Your people together as a shepherd tends his flock, we lift up our brother Grayson before Your throne of grace. Just as You surrounded the early church with fellow believers who encouraged one another daily (Hebrews 10:24-25), we ask that You would guide Grayson to a life-giving community of faith in Boston. Lord, prepare the hearts of those who will become his spiritual family, and create divine appointments that will lead him to the exact place where his faith will be strengthened and his walk with You will deepen. May this community become a source of accountability, encouragement, and spiritual growth in his life. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Please pray for my campus access to be granted miraculously
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You are the one who opens doors that no one can shut. We lift up our friend who seeks access to further their education - You know their heart's desire to learn and grow. As You helped Daniel find favor in Babylon, we ask that You would grant this student supernatural favor with administrators and clear any obstacles standing in their way. May Your mighty hand move swiftly to provide the campus access they need, for Your Word promises that when we commit our ways to You, You will act on our behalf (Psalm 37:5). Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: I give thanks to connectchurch and their 508 event that happened today. Please allow the volunteers and staff that hosted the event to not fall into trials and temptations.
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, we thank You for blessing 'the508' event at Connect Church, Ashland today. We lift up the faithful servants who gave their time and energy to minister to others. Guard their hearts and minds in Christ Jesus, strengthening them against temptation and spiritual attacks. As You promised in 1 Corinthians 10:13, provide these dedicated volunteers and staff members with a way of escape in moments of trial. Pour out Your protection and renewed spiritual vigor upon these servants, that they may continue to shine Your light and build Your kingdom. Amen.

author: NinaC
original_request: For Andrew to find his way back to a happy healthy life
generated_prayer: Loving Father, who promises to restore the years the locusts have eaten (Joel 2:25), we lift up our brother Andrew to You today. Guide his footsteps back to the path of wholeness and joy, surrounding him with Your perfect peace that passes all understanding. Grant him wisdom to make healthy choices, strength to overcome obstacles, and the deep assurance that You have plans to give him hope and a future. Let Your healing presence fill every area of his life, restoring him to the abundant life You have promised. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Tori to have consistent trust in the universe and for this to spread out into the universe
generated_prayer: Loving Creator, You promise to work all things together for good for those who love You. We lift up our sister Tori, asking that You strengthen her faith and deepen her trust in Your perfect plan. As You led Abraham to trust You step by step, guide Tori to rest confidently in Your sovereign care. May her growing trust become a beacon of hope that inspires others to place their confidence in You, creating ripples of faith throughout our community. Let her life reflect the peace that comes from knowing You hold all things in Your hands, as Your word reminds us that You are faithful to complete the good work You have begun (Philippians 1:6). Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Ben to find a job soon
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, provider of all good things, we lift up our brother Ben to You in his search for employment. Just as You provided for Your people in the wilderness and promised that You know the plans You have for us (Jeremiah 29:11), we ask that You would open doors of opportunity for Ben and guide him to the right position where his gifts can be used for Your glory. Grant him patience and peace during this season of waiting, and give him wisdom to discern the path You have prepared. We trust in Your perfect timing and provision. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Henry’s startup to take off and help him bring glory to God
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, we lift up our brother Henry and his startup venture. As You blessed the work of Joseph's hands in Egypt and Daniel's leadership in Babylon, we ask that You would prosper this business for Your glory. Grant Henry wisdom like Solomon to make sound decisions, divine connections with the right partners, and favor with potential clients. May this endeavor not only provide for his needs but become a powerful testimony of Your faithfulness, allowing him to be a light in the marketplace and use his success to advance Your kingdom. Through Christ our Lord, Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Lord, I pray that the people of New England who are filled and convicted with the fire of the Holy Spirit work hard with God to ingrain habits into their hearts - that way, they are prepared to survive future spiritual wilderness without getting far away from God
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, we lift up our brothers and sisters in New England who are currently filled with the Spirit and burning with passion about serving you. As You promised to never leave nor forsake Your people (Hebrews 13:5), strengthen their spiritual disciplines and help them develop holy habits that will anchor their souls during times of testing. Pour out Your Spirit upon them, that they might be rooted and grounded in Your love, able to stand firm in both abundance and wilderness. Grant them the wisdom and perseverance to establish lasting patterns of prayer, worship, and meditation on Your Word, so their faith may remain steadfast through every season, especially including in spiritual wilderness and temptations. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Fast recovery of Michelle's mom and for Michelle's strength when assisting her mother
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, we lift up Michelle and her mother to Your throne of mercy today. As the One who promised to be our Healer (Exodus 15:26), we ask for Your healing touch upon Michelle's mother's body, bringing swift recovery and renewed strength. Grant our sister Michelle the physical, emotional and spiritual stamina she needs to care for her mother, remembering Your promise that those who hope in You will renew their strength and soar on wings like eagles (Isaiah 40:31). Surround this family with Your peace and provision, and may they feel Your presence in every moment of this journey. Amen.
testimony: The healing was super smooth, and it resulted in praise and glory to God!

author: ilyag
original_request: The war in the Middle East must end
generated_prayer: Merciful Father, Prince of Peace, we lift up to You the devastating conflict in the Middle East. As Your word promises that You will bring peace to all nations (Isaiah 2:4), we ask for Your divine intervention to end the bloodshed and heal these ancient wounds. Grant wisdom and humility to all leaders involved, soften hardened hearts, and protect innocent civilians caught in the crossfire. Lord, bring Your perfect peace that surpasses understanding to this region, and help Your children recognize their common humanity as those created in Your image. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Harrison to go to church more
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You promise that where two or three gather in Your name, You are there among them (Matthew 18:20). We lift up our brother Harrison, asking that You would stir in his heart a deeper hunger for fellowship with You and Your people. Plant within him a lasting desire to worship in Your house and to grow closer to You through regular communion with other believers. Guide his steps to a church home where he can be spiritually nourished, use his gifts to serve others, and experience the joy of Your presence. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our sister’s father follow up appointment after his surgery and our brother to be a good supportive husband
generated_prayer: Loving Father, we lift up our sister's father as he continues his journey of healing. Watch over him during his follow-up appointment, guiding the medical team with Your wisdom as they assess his recovery. Grant our brother the strength, patience, and understanding to be the supportive husband You have called him to be, remembering that love is patient and kind (1 Corinthians 13:4). May Your presence bring peace to this family, and may they feel Your sustaining grace in every moment. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For E’s inlaws in Florida
generated_prayer: Gracious Father in Heaven, We lift up E's dear in-laws in Florida to Your loving care. As You promised to be a shelter from the storm and a refuge in times of trouble (Psalm 46:1), we ask that You would protect and watch over them. Grant them good health, safety, and peace in their daily lives. Surround them with Your presence and loving kindness, and draw them closer to You and to their family. May they experience the depth of Your love and the comfort of Your Spirit in tangible ways. In Jesus' name we pray, Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: God, please stir up the passion of holy scripture in all of us
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Author of all Truth, we lift up this request for a deeper love of Your Word. Just as You promised that Your Word would be a lamp to our feet and a light to our path (Psalm 119:105), kindle in our community a renewed hunger for Your holy scriptures. Pour out Your Spirit upon us, that we might not only read but truly cherish every word You have preserved for our instruction and encouragement. May Your living Word transform our hearts and minds, drawing us ever closer to You. Amen.

author: Benjamin Paine
original_request: For the victims of the plane crash in Bangladesh and their families
generated_prayer: Merciful Father, who comforts those who mourn and heals the brokenhearted, we lift up the victims of the Bangladesh plane crash and their grieving families. Grant peace and strength to those who have lost loved ones, and surround them with Your tender care in this time of profound sorrow. As You promised in Psalm 34:18 to be near the brokenhearted, draw especially close to these families, guiding them through the valley of shadows with Your unfailing love. Lord, provide wisdom and support to the rescue workers, medical teams, and all those helping in the aftermath of this tragedy. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Sarah’s aunt Trish, who just received a cancer diagnosis
generated_prayer: Loving Father, we lift up our sister Trish as she faces this challenging cancer diagnosis. Just as You promised to be our Healer in Exodus 15:26, we ask for Your healing touch upon her body and Your perfect peace to guard her heart and mind. Grant wisdom to her medical team, strength to Sarah and all who support her, and fill Trish with the confident hope that comes from knowing You are with her through every step of this journey. May she feel Your presence in tangible ways and experience Your healing power. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Blessing for our daily thywill.live prayer meetings
generated_prayer: Gracious Father in Heaven, We thank You for gathering us together as Your people in these prayer meetings. Just as You promised that where two or three gather in Your name, You are there among us (Matthew 18:20), we ask for Your manifest presence in our midst. Pour out Your Spirit upon this community, granting us unity of heart and purpose as we lift our voices to You. May these meetings be vessels of Your power, bringing transformation to lives, healing to hearts, and glory to Your name. Guide each person who joins, whether leading or participating, that we might pray according to Your perfect will. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Protection against lust
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, You are holy and pure, the One who gives us power to live righteously. We lift up our friend who seeks victory over lustful thoughts and desires. Just as You promised that Your grace is sufficient and Your power is made perfect in weakness (2 Corinthians 12:9), we ask You to strengthen them with Your mighty hand. Guard their eyes, protect their heart, and renew their mind with pure thoughts that honor You. Lead them into the freedom that comes through Your Spirit, and surround them with godly relationships that encourage holy living. Amen.

author: ffanderson
original_request: For my grandmother who passed away last week. I’d like to pray for my father to allow himself to grieve and be comforted by his family who loves him.
generated_prayer: Loving Father, who comforts us in all our sorrows (2 Corinthians 1:3-4), we lift up our brother as he mourns the loss of his mother. Grant him the freedom to express his grief and the courage to lean on those around him who wish to share his burden. We pray that Your peace, which surpasses all understanding, would guard his heart during this difficult season, and that he would feel Your presence through the loving embrace of his family. As You promised to be close to the brokenhearted (Psalm 34:18), draw near to him now and heal his wounded spirit. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Good health for Trinity
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You are the Great Physician and the source of all healing. We lift up Trinity to You, asking that You would restore and strengthen their body according to Your perfect will. Just as You promised in Exodus 15:26 that You are the Lord who heals, we pray that You would surround our friend with Your healing presence, grant them renewed vitality, and protect them from illness. Guide the medical professionals who care for Trinity, and fill them with Your wisdom. In Your merciful name we pray. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our sister Mal to learn how to balance her life
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Source of all wisdom and peace, we lift up our sister Mal to You today. As You promised to give wisdom generously to all who ask (James 1:5), grant her discernment to order her days according to Your perfect will. Help her distinguish between the essential and the urgent, creating healthy boundaries that honor You and care for the life You've given her. Guide her steps, Lord, that she may find rest for her soul while faithfully fulfilling the calling You've placed on her life. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For uncle Keith to be treated well by the nurses at the hospital
generated_prayer: Gracious Father in Heaven, we lift up our brother Keith to You as he receives care in the hospital. Just as You showed compassion to the sick and hurting during Your ministry on earth, we ask that You would move in the hearts of the nurses caring for him, filling them with kindness, attentiveness, and genuine concern (Matthew 25:36). Grant Keith peace during this time of vulnerability, and surround him with healthcare workers who will treat him with dignity and respect. May he feel Your presence and comfort through their gentle hands and caring hearts. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Good vibes and happy life for Alex
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, We lift up our friend Alex to You today, knowing that You are the source of all joy and abundance. You are the giver of every good and perfect gift (James 1:17). We ask that You would shower Alex with Your blessings and fill their days with genuine happiness. Grant them peace that surpasses understanding, meaningful relationships that bring joy, and opportunities that lead to fulfillment. May Alex experience the richness of Your love and the warmth of Your presence in every aspect of their life. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Kevin to get help with finishing his construction project in Boston Fenway area
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Provider of all good things, we lift up our brother Kevin to You as he works to complete his construction project in the Fenway area. Just as You guided the skilled craftsmen who built Your temple with wisdom and excellence, we ask that You would send the right help and resources to Kevin at this time. Grant him favor with contractors, clear direction in decision-making, and protection over all who work on this project. As Your Word promises that You will "establish the work of our hands" (Psalm 90:17), we pray for Your divine establishment of this construction work, bringing it to successful completion in Your perfect timing. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For us to worship God, not pleasure
generated_prayer: Gracious Father in Heaven, we lift up our friend who desires to put You first in their life. Help them to find their deepest satisfaction in Your presence, remembering Your promise that in Your presence is fullness of joy (Psalm 16:11). Transform their heart's desires until they can truly say like David that You alone are their portion and their cup. Give them wisdom to recognize when they are making idols of earthly pleasures, and grant them the strength to surrender those things at Your feet. May they experience the truth that You are most glorified when they are most satisfied in You. Amen.

author: Mark
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Source of all wisdom and understanding, we lift up our friend who seeks to more deeply grasp Your teachings about humble service. Open their spiritual eyes to fully comprehend the profound lessons of the vineyard parable and Luke 17:7-10 that we are simply unworthy servants doing what we ought to do. Grant them the humility of heart to serve without seeking recognition, remembering Your Son who came not to be served but to serve. As Your Word declares in Philippians 2:3-4, help them to value others above themselves, looking to the interests of others. May Your Holy Spirit illuminate these scriptures in their mind and transform their understanding into living practice. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For Grayson's siblings and dad to be changed by God's hesed
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You who demonstrated perfect love through Your Son, we lift up Grayson's family to You today. As You promised to be faithful to a thousand generations of those who love You (Deuteronomy 7:9), pour out Your unfailing hesed love upon their father and siblings. Transform their hearts through Your tender mercy, drawing them into a deeper understanding of Your grace and truth. May Your Spirit work powerfully in their lives, bringing healing to relationships and opening their eyes to Your boundless love, just as You transformed Saul on the road to Damascus. We trust in Your perfect timing and Your desire that none should perish, but that all should come to repentance. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For us to know who our real employer is, and for software developers to offer up their life and their attitude of work as a submission to God, rather than a 'finished' product to the human eye
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Provider of all good gifts and talents, we lift up these software developers who seek to honor You through their work. Help them remember that they ultimately serve You, not human masters or themselves, as Your Word reminds us in Colossians 3:23. Grant them wisdom to see their code and creations as acts of worship, offering each project with humility and excellence for Your glory. Guide them to maintain pure motives and a servant's heart, trusting in Your perfect timing rather than earthly deadlines. May their work be a testament to Your creativity and order in all things. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Juan and for his apartment move to be less stressful and more filled with the Spirit
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, our loving Provider, we lift up our brother Juan during this time of transition. Just as You guided the Israelites through their journey with Your pillar of cloud and fire, we ask that You guide Juan's steps and decisions during his move. Grant him Your perfect peace that surpasses understanding (Philippians 4:7), and fill his new home with the warmth of Your presence. May Your Spirit transform this potentially stressful time into one of joy and gratitude, providing the strength, resources, and helping hands he needs. In Jesus' name, Amen.
testimony: Juan (Real name John) was successful in moving, although he is still unpacking. He was happy to finish! Praise the Lord!

author: ilyag
original_request: For Kevin Simmons to be safe and healthy and supported by his family and friends
generated_prayer: Loving Father, we lift up our brother Kevin before Your throne of grace. Just as You promised to be a shield and fortress for Your people, we ask that You surround him with Your divine protection and fill his body with strength and wellness. Lord, as You surrounded David with faithful companions like Jonathan, we pray that You would strengthen the bonds between Kevin and his loved ones, drawing his family and friends closer to provide the encouragement and support he needs. Guide them to be Your hands and feet in his life, showing Your love in tangible ways. Through Christ our Lord, Amen. (Psalm 28:7)

author: Mark
original_request: To discern good and bad criticism and anger - I find myself getting deceived into overly lenient view on sin or overly angry and judgmental views without love
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, source of all wisdom and truth, we lift up our brother/sister who seeks Your divine discernment. Grant them Your perfect balance of righteousness and mercy, as You have shown us through Christ Jesus who was "full of grace and truth" (John 1:14). Help them distinguish between godly conviction and human condemnation, giving them eyes to see sin as You see it - with both justice and redemptive love. Lord, protect their heart from deception while filling them with Your Spirit of wisdom, that they may respond to wrongdoing with Your perfect blend of holiness and compassion. Guide them to that sacred place where truth and love meet, just as Your Word declares that we should "speak the truth in love" (Ephesians 4:15). Amen.
testimony: Ilya shared Psalm 37 with me today - a psalm that gives wisdom on anger. Thank you for this gift, and please allow my limited brain and heart to fully soak in this wisdom like a sponge and actually apply it in my life. Lord be praised!!

author: ilyag
original_request: For our sister Olesya’s children’s continued health
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You have promised to watch over our children like a shepherd tends his flock. We lift up our sister Olesya's precious children to Your throne of grace, asking for Your divine protection over their bodies, minds, and spirits. As You declared in Psalm 91, let Your angels guard them in all their ways. Grant them vibrant health, strong immune systems, and the vigor to grow and flourish as they develop into the people You created them to be. Through Christ our Lord, Amen.

author: Plant
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, we lift up our sister who steps out in faith to start this virtual small group. As they guide others through foundations of faith, we ask that You would grant them wisdom, discernment, and confidence, remembering Your promise that when we lack wisdom, we need only ask (James 1:5). Lord, bless each participant in this six-week journey, and use this time to nurture deep spiritual growth and authentic connections. May Your Holy Spirit work powerfully through their study, discussions, and fellowship, creating lasting impact that extends far beyond these weeks together. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our brother and sister expecting a boy, to consecrate him to the Lord, and healthy baby, healthy momma
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You knit each precious life together in the womb and we thank You for the gift of this little boy You are forming. Just as Hannah dedicated Samuel to Your service, we lift up this couple's son, asking You to set him apart for Your purposes. Watch over this pregnancy, protecting both mother and child in Your tender care. Grant wisdom to the medical team, peace to these expectant parents, and bring this baby safely into the world in Your perfect timing. May this child grow to know You, love You, and walk in the destiny You have prepared for him, just as You promised in Jeremiah 1:5. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For James’ friends and family to turn to Christ
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You promise in Your Word that You desire all people to come to knowledge of the truth and be saved. We lift up the friends and family of James to You today, asking that You would open their hearts to receive Your Son Jesus Christ. Just as You drew Lydia's heart to respond to Paul's message in Acts 16, draw these precious souls to Yourself. Grant them eyes to see Your glory, ears to hear Your truth, and hearts soft to Your gentle calling. May Your Holy Spirit work powerfully in their lives, bringing them into Your family and filling James with joy as he witnesses their transformation. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For me to remember the horrible person that I once was before Jesus changed my life, so that I can truly understand how powerful Jesus is and what his unconditional love really means
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, who makes all things new, we lift up our brother who has been transformed by Your redeeming love. Help him to remember his past not with shame, but as a testament to Your amazing grace and power to change lives. As Your Word promises that You remove our sins as far as the east is from the west (Psalm 103:12), let this remembrance deepen his gratitude and strengthen his witness of Your unconditional love. May they, like Paul, use their story of transformation to encourage others and bring glory to Your name. Amen.
testimony: By praying this prayer, I am led to remember. Praise God

author: Mark
original_request: For Ilya to gain a super buff of the Spirit especially this week - discipline, strengthened prayer, protection, discernment, constant practice of the presence of God, etc.
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, Giver of every good and perfect gift, we lift up our brother Ilya to You. Pour out Your Spirit upon him in extraordinary measure this week, just as You promised to pour out Your Spirit on all flesh (Joel 2:28). Strengthen his inner being with power through Your Spirit, grant him divine discipline in seeking Your face, and surround him with Your protective presence. Lord, sharpen his spiritual discernment and help him remain constantly aware of Your presence, walking in step with Your Spirit moment by moment. May he experience the fullness of Your power and grace as he pursues deeper intimacy with You. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For John's creative arts ministry to be blessed and for him to have a time of constant prayer and intimacy with God this week
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You are the source of all creativity and beauty. We lift up our brother John and his creative arts ministry to You, remembering how You filled Bezalel with Your Spirit, with wisdom and understanding in artistic works (Exodus 31:3). Draw John into deeper intimacy with You this week, creating sacred spaces of uninterrupted prayer where he can rest in Your presence. May Your Spirit anoint his creative endeavors, using them to bring glory to Your name and touch hearts for Your kingdom. Grant him clarity of vision, renewed inspiration, and a profound sense of Your nearness as he serves You through his artistic gifts. Amen.
testimony: John went to a creative arts retreat, and he was so blessed and filled in it. Praise be to God!!!

author: ilyag
original_request: A world where humanity is socially liberated
generated_prayer: Loving Creator, You made all people in Your divine image and declared it very good. We lift our hearts in prayer for a world where Your children can live in true freedom and dignity. Guide humanity toward the fulfillment of Your promise that all nations will be blessed (Genesis 12:3). Break down the walls that divide us, heal the wounds of prejudice and oppression, and help us see one another through Your eyes of perfect love. Grant wisdom to leaders and courage to all who work for justice, that Your kingdom may come on earth as it is in heaven. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For people with mental health struggles to praies God and give thanks to him when things are hard
generated_prayer: Loving Father, we lift up our brothers and sisters who face mental health challenges. As You promised to be near to the brokenhearted and save the crushed in spirit (Psalm 34:18), draw close to them now. Grant them moments of clarity to see Your goodness even in difficult seasons, and give them strength to offer praise when their hearts feel heavy. Help them remember that You are the God who turns mourning into dancing, and that Your faithfulness endures through every storm. May Your Spirit comfort them and remind them that nothing can separate them from Your love, just as You assured us through Paul in Romans 8:38-39. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our brother Rainier’s family’s travels
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, who led Your people through the wilderness and guided the wise men by Your star, we lift up our brother Rainier's family as they journey. Watch over them as they travel, surround them with Your protective angels, and grant them safe passage to their destination and back home again. Just as You promised to be with Joshua wherever he went (Joshua 1:9), be present with this family, keeping them secure in Your care and blessing their time together. Through Christ our Lord, Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For the world to heal and for the world leaders to lead it in the right direction.
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Source of all wisdom and peace, we lift up our world's leaders to You today. As You guided kings and rulers throughout history, we ask You to grant these leaders wisdom, discernment, and compassionate hearts. Pour out Your healing spirit upon our troubled world, bringing reconciliation where there is conflict and understanding where there is division. Just as You promised Solomon wisdom to govern Your people (1 Kings 3:9), we pray that You would guide today's leaders to make decisions that promote justice, peace, and the flourishing of all Your children. Let Your kingdom come and Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Rosalind's work
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Provider of all good things, we lift up our sister Rosalind and her work before Your throne. As You promised to bless the work of our hands in Deuteronomy 28:12, we ask that You would prosper her efforts and grant her wisdom in all her professional endeavors. Guide her steps, open doors of opportunity, and help her to serve others through her work with excellence and integrity. May she find fulfillment in her calling and be a light that glorifies You in her workplace. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For a church brother's independent bible reading + bible reading together with his wife to go well
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You who gave us Your Word as a lamp to our feet and a light to our path, we lift up our brother and his desire to grow in Your truth. Guide him as he studies Scripture independently and bless the precious time he shares reading Your Word with his wife. May their joint meditation on Your promises deepen their relationship with You and with each other, as You promised in Ecclesiastes 4:12 that a cord of three strands is not quickly broken. Grant them wisdom, understanding, and the joy of discovering Your truths together. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: An acknowledgement, Lord, as we all ask you for things that we desire - you are good, always good. Your holiness cannot be described by human intellect, and it never changes whether we please you or commit sin.
generated_prayer: Holy Father, we pause to acknowledge Your unchanging goodness and perfect holiness that transcends all human understanding. As Your Word declares, "Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shadow of change" (James 1:17). Thank You that Your character remains constant regardless of our actions or attitudes. We rest in the assurance of Your steadfast nature and trust in Your perfect wisdom before Your throne. You are eternally good and faithful. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our sister ak’s healing
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You are Jehovah Rapha, the God who heals. We lift up our sister before Your throne of grace, asking for Your healing touch upon her body, mind, and spirit. As You promised in Jeremiah 30:17 that You would restore health and heal wounds, we claim this promise for our sister today. Grant her medical team wisdom, fill her heart with peace that surpasses understanding, and strengthen her faith as she walks this journey of recovery. In the name of Jesus, our Great Physician, we pray. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Please empower us in our struggle with lust and forgive us when we, despite being made new in you, continue to sin and lose to the flesh
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You who created us in Your image and called us to live holy lives, we lift up our friend who struggles against the temptations of the flesh. As You promised in 1 Corinthians 10:13 to provide a way of escape in every temptation, we ask You to strengthen them with Your mighty power and guard their heart and mind. Lord, when they stumble, remind them of Your unfailing mercy and the cleansing power of Christ's blood. Grant them wisdom to flee from temptation, fill them with Your Holy Spirit, and help them to see themselves as You see them - beloved, forgiven, and made new in Christ. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For my parents to have restful and peaceful sleep
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You give Your beloved sleep and grant sweet rest to those who trust in You. We lift up these dear parents, asking that You would surround their bedroom with Your peace that surpasses understanding. As they lay down each night, calm their minds, ease their bodies, and fill them with the restful assurance of Your constant care. Grant them the rejuvenating sleep that You promised to those who dwell in Your shelter (Psalm 127:2). Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Tucker, more clarity on what he wants to do
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Giver of wisdom and purpose, we lift up our brother Tucker to You today. As You promised to give wisdom generously to all who ask (James 1:5), we pray that You would illuminate Tucker's path and make his purpose clear. Grant him discernment to recognize the gifts You've placed within him and the courage to pursue the calling You've written on his heart. May Your Holy Spirit guide his thoughts, open the right doors, and give him peace as he seeks to understand Your perfect will for his life. Amen.
testimony: I ended up encountering many serendipitous situations after this prayer and gained a lot more clarity and got a job in the industry I was hoping to land in. ThyWill is great!

author: Mark
original_request: For aletheia praise team to get a good voice recovery from today's praise event and to get a intimate pleasant experience with God
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You who created every voice to sing Your praises, we lift up the Aletheia praise team to You. Grant them rest and restoration for their voices after serving in worship, and renew their physical strength as promised in Isaiah 40:31. Draw them into deeper intimacy with You, Lord, that they might experience the joy of Your presence as David did when he danced before You with all his might. May their service in Your courts bring them ever closer to Your heart, that they might know the sweetness of dwelling in Your house. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Selena’s mother’s health. She recently fainted and is far away in China with family.
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Source of all healing and comfort, we lift up Selena's mother to Your loving care. As You promised to be near to all who call upon You (Psalm 145:18), draw especially close to her in China, surrounded by family yet far from her daughter. Grant her doctors wisdom to understand the cause of her fainting, and restore her strength and vitality. Lord, we ask that You would ease Selena's worried heart and give her peace, knowing that Your presence transcends all distance. Watch over this precious mother and protect her with Your mighty hand. Amen.
testimony: She’s still in the hospital, but she’s feeling much better now!

author: ilyag
original_request: For the bar advocates of Massachusetts to get paid enough
generated_prayer: Gracious and Just Lord, who established laws and justice through Your servant Moses, we lift up the bar advocates of Massachusetts who serve as voices for those in need. As You promise in Proverbs 31:9 to "defend the rights of the poor and needy," we ask You to ensure these dedicated attorneys receive fair compensation for their important work. Grant wisdom to those in authority to recognize and properly value the essential service these advocates provide to our justice system. May You open the way for appropriate funding and resources, so these servants of justice can continue their vital mission of ensuring equal access to legal representation for all. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Milton’s one-week daughter
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You who created and cherish every precious life, we lift up Milton's newborn daughter into Your tender care. As Your Word says that You are compassionate and gracious, abounding in love for all You have made (Psalm 145:8-9), draw especially close to this tiny one in her first days of life. Grant her strength, protect her developing body, and surround her with Your healing presence. Lord, give Milton and his family wisdom, peace, and endurance as they nurture this precious gift You have entrusted to them. Watch over this little one as the Good Shepherd You are, carrying her close to Your heart. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our brother Mark to have a good time with his family
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You created families and called them good. We lift up our brother Mark and ask that You bless his time with his loved ones. As You promised to give good gifts to Your children (Matthew 7:11), shower this family gathering with joy, meaningful connection, and memories that draw them closer to each other and to You. Let Your peace reign in their midst and Your love flow through their conversations and activities. Amen.
testimony: Mark is having a great time with his family!

author: Mark
original_request: For Ilya's future scavenger hunt events - and for it to lead people to end up scavenger hunting for God
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You are the One who said "seek and you will find" (Matthew 7:7). We lift up our brother Ilya and the scavenger hunt You've placed on his life. Guide him as he creates paths that will lead participants not only to earthly treasures, but ultimately to the greatest treasure of all - a relationship with You. Lord, just as You used parables and object lessons to reveal spiritual truths, we pray that through these events, seekers will discover Your presence in unexpected places and recognize Your handiwork in their journey. May Your Holy Spirit work through Ilya's planning and preparation, transforming these adventures into opportunities for divine encounters. Amen.
testimony: It went well!

author: Mark
original_request: For a revived Crepe restaurant in New Hampshire not to die again, unless it is your will that they fall
generated_prayer: Gracious Provider and Lord of all endeavors, we lift up a Crepe restaurant in New Hampshire to Your capable hands. As You sustained the widow's oil and flour in Elijah's time (1 Kings 17:16), we ask that You would provide the resources, customers, and wisdom needed for this business to flourish according to Your perfect will. Grant the owners and staff discernment to make sound decisions, creativity to serve their community well, and hearts that seek Your guidance in all they do. If it be Your will to prosper this establishment, may it become a place of blessing and fellowship for many. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For a church brother's grandmother who is in the hospital and in a wheelchair because of a stroke - and blessing for her arm that does not move after the stroke
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, our Great Physician and Healer, we lift up our brother's beloved grandmother to Your throne of grace. As You promised in Psalm 103 to heal all our diseases, we ask for Your healing touch upon her body, especially her arm that has been affected by this stroke. Lord, grant her strength to persevere through rehabilitation, comfort her spirit during this challenging season, and give wisdom to her medical team. May she experience Your presence in a special way as she recovers in the hospital, and may her faith be strengthened even through this trial. We trust in Your unfailing love and healing power, knowing that You are the God who makes all things new. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For a Christian brother to escape all mentality of Christian legalism and pride and to feel comfort and motivation in acknowledging and receiving the grace of Jesus
generated_prayer: Loving Father, who sent Your Son to set us free from the burden of legalism, we lift up our brother who struggles with pride and religious perfectionism. Just as You promised in Matthew 11:30 that Your yoke is easy and Your burden is light, help them experience the liberating truth that we are saved by grace through faith, not by works. Release them from the chains of self-righteousness and fill their heart with the deep comfort of Your unconditional love. May Your Holy Spirit guide them into a fresh revelation of Jesus' finished work on the cross, bringing newfound joy and freedom in their walk with You. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For safe travels for Kevin as he visits family in China and also sees the social and cultural progress that's happened in the country since 10 years ago
generated_prayer: Loving Father, who watches over all Your children, we lift up our brother Kevin as he journeys to China. Just as You guided the wise men from the East with Your star, guide and protect him in all his travels and reunions with family. Grant him discerning eyes to witness the changes in the land and culture, and fill his heart with wisdom to understand the transformations he observes. As You promised in Psalm 91, command Your angels to guard him in all his ways. We ask for Your divine protection over every flight, every step, and every encounter, that he may return safely with enriched understanding and cherished memories. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For the recovery and health of Megan’s wrist, including giving her the wisdom to rest if needed. Either let it heal on its own or guide her to Godly medical help
generated_prayer: Loving Creator, You are the Great Physician who heals all our diseases and binds up our wounds. We lift up our sister Megan's wrist to You, asking for Your healing touch and restoration. Grant her wisdom to discern when to rest and when to seek medical care. As You promised in Jeremiah 30:17 that You would restore health and heal wounds, we trust You to bring complete healing to Megan's body. Let her feel Your presence and peace during this time of recovery. Amen.
testimony: It's healed, and not bothering anymore!

author: ilyag
original_request: For Allison’s health, she said that her eyes were hurting.
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You are the Great Physician who formed every part of our bodies with perfect care. We lift up our sister Allison to You, asking for Your healing touch upon her eyes. As You promised in Exodus 15:26 that You are the Lord who heals us, we pray that You would ease her discomfort, restore proper function to her vision, and grant her medical team wisdom in treating any underlying causes. May she feel Your presence and peace as she awaits restoration. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our sister Megan’s housing, to find a place and support in our house and community and assimilate happily and with joy and positive growth for all involved
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, provider of every good gift, we lift up our sister Megan as she seeks a dwelling place within this community. Just as You prepared a home for Ruth among Your people (Ruth 2:12), we ask that You guide Megan to the right living situation where she can flourish and grow. Grant wisdom and discernment to all involved in this transition, creating an environment of mutual blessing and joyful fellowship. May this new chapter bring glory to Your name as You knit hearts together in Christian love, fostering genuine community and spiritual growth for everyone involved. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Max’s safety at sea
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, Protector of all who venture upon the waters, we lift up our brother Max to Your loving care. Just as You calmed the storm and guided Your disciples safely across the sea, we ask that You would surround him with Your divine protection and grant him wisdom in navigation. Guard him against all dangers, shelter him in Your mighty hand, and bring him safely to harbor according to Your perfect timing. As Your Word promises that "He who commands the winds and waves" is forever watchful over Your children (Luke 8:25), keep Max secure in Your sovereign care. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For rest and courage for Raymond
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, our loving God who gives rest to the weary and strength to the weak, we lift up our brother Raymond to You today. Just as You promised rest for all who come to You with heavy burdens, grant Raymond peaceful rest for his body, mind, and spirit. Fill him with the same courage You gave to Joshua when You commanded him to be strong and courageous, knowing You would be with him wherever he went. Lord, renew his strength so that he may soar on wings like eagles, run and not grow weary, walk and not faint, as You promised in Isaiah 40:31. In Your merciful name we pray. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Ilya and David's finance

Grant them clarity in financial decisions, freedom from anxiety about money, and the peace that comes from trusting in Your faithful provision. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Please protect and deliver this website from trolls and malicious users

Guard this space against those who would seek to harm or disrupt it, and grant wisdom to those who maintain and moderate it. As You promised in Isaiah 54:17 that no weapon formed against Your people would prosper, we ask for Your divine protection over this platform and its users. Help this to remain a place of meaningful connection, support, and spiritual growth for all who gather here. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Shirin's health
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You are the Great Physician who heals all our diseases. We lift up our sister Shirin to Your throne of grace today, asking for Your healing touch upon her body. Grant her doctors wisdom in their treatment, fill her heart with peace that surpasses understanding, and strengthen her faith through this journey. In the name of Jesus, our Healer, we pray. Amen.

author: D Cu
original_request: Pray for George to experience the Gospel
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You who loved the world so much that You sent Your only Son, we lift up our brother George to You today. Open his eyes to see the beauty of Your grace and the power of the Gospel message, just as You opened Lydia's heart to respond to Paul's teaching. We ask that Your Holy Spirit would work in George's life, drawing him to the saving knowledge of Jesus Christ, for You have promised that all who seek You with their whole heart will find You. May he come to know the depths of Your love and the freedom found in Christ alone. (Acts 16:14; Jeremiah 29:13)

author: ilyag
original_request: For Elise's health, and wisdom to balance health and work.
generated_prayer: Loving Father, we lift up our sister Elise to You today. As the One who gives rest to the weary and strength to the weak (Isaiah 40:29), we ask You to restore her body and spirit after this season of overwork and exhaustion. Grant her the wisdom to establish healthy boundaries and the courage to honor them, remembering that her body is Your temple (1 Corinthians 6:19-20). Lord, give Elise discernment to balance her passion for serving others with proper self-care. Help her to embrace the rhythm of rest You modeled in creation, and show her that true productivity flows from a well-nourished spirit. Guide her steps as she leads and creates, that she might inspire others not just through her work, but through her wholeness. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For us to know that God is watching, proctoring, and gazing on us - and for that to raise the awe, reverance, and fear of God in our actions
generated_prayer: Gracious and Holy Father, who sees all things and from whom nothing is hidden, we lift up ourselves before You. As You reminded Your servant David that Your eyes are always upon us (Psalm 139:1-4), we ask that You would heighten our awareness of Your constant, loving presence. Help us to walk in reverent awe of Your majesty with the deep respect that transforms daily choices and actions. May we, like Isaiah, catch a glimpse of Your holiness that stuns us and forever changes how we live and move in this world. Let Your Spirit remind us moment by moment that we stand on holy ground in Your presence. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: A partner and spouse for our brother Kennedy and our sister Faith
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You created marriage as a beautiful gift and declared that it is not good for man to be alone. We lift up our brother Kennedy and our sister Faith to You, asking that You would prepare their hearts and bring them each a godly spouse in Your perfect timing. Just as You provided Eve for Adam and Ruth for Boaz, guide them to partners who will strengthen their faith, share their values, and walk alongside them in pursuing Your purposes. May they trust in Your promise that You withhold no good thing from those who walk uprightly (Psalm 84:11). Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Ryan to meet a nice woman
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You created us for relationship and declared that it is not good for man to be alone. We lift up our brother Ryan to You, asking that You would bring a godly woman into his life according to Your perfect timing. Just as You provided Eve for Adam and Ruth for Boaz, guide Ryan's path to intersect with someone who will share his values, strengthen his faith, and walk alongside him in devoted partnership. May Your wisdom direct his steps and guard his heart as he seeks the companion You have prepared for him. In Jesus' name, Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: A job for brother Usman
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, provider of all good things, we lift up our brother Usman in his search for employment. As You promised to supply all our needs according to Your riches in glory (Philippians 4:19), we ask that You would open doors of opportunity for him and guide his steps to the right workplace. May this employment bring honor to Your name and allow him to be a light in his workplace. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For a church brother's Christian book (that he is writing) to go well
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Author of all wisdom and truth, we lift up our brother's writing endeavor to You. Grant him clarity of mind, creativity of expression, and steadfast dedication to complete this work. May this book become a vessel of Your truth that draws readers closer to Your heart and transforms lives for Your glory. In Jesus' name, Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Prayer for the preservation of endangered Jewel Beetles, and that their appearance can remind people of God
generated_prayer: Gracious Creator, who adorns Your world with beauty and fills it with wonders, we lift up the endangered Jewel Beetles to Your care. Grant wisdom to those working to protect these creatures, and help humanity become better stewards of the intricate web of life You have entrusted to our care. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For all members of AugHacks to use the event to see God with a unique flavor
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Light of Wisdom and Source of all Creativity, Guide the members of AugHacks as they gather to create and innovate. author: ilyag
original_request: For Luke’s startup to take off and financial situation
generated_prayer: Gracious Provider, You who own the cattle on a thousand hills and promise to supply all our needs according to Your riches in glory, we lift up our brother Luke to You. (Psalm 50:10, Philippians 4:19)

author: Mark
original_request: For us to recognize that God's ways are not that of human wisdom; to know that wisdom is the fear of the Lord; and to understand that in the things that we feel most confident in, we are the most blind in
generated_prayer: Gracious and All-Wise God, You who declared that the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, we lift up those who seek true understanding. Help us release any pride in worldly wisdom and embrace Your perfect truth with humility and reverence. Lord, in the areas where we feel most certain, give us the grace to pause and seek Your counsel first, knowing that You alone are the source of all wisdom and understanding. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Candace’s husband’s health
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You are the Great Physician who heals all our diseases. author: Mark
original_request: For a ministry consultant and his wife's reduction in stress and for their boys to behave in a way that is filled with the Spirit and does not make them stumble
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Prince of Peace, we lift up our brother, Your servant in ministry, and his beloved wife. Just as You shepherded Your people Israel with tender care, shepherd this family through their daily challenges, replacing chaos with Your divine order and stress with Your sustaining grace. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For Ilya to gain wisdom as he develops prayer editing feature (and wisdom on if he should develop it at all)
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Source of all wisdom and understanding, we lift up our brother Ilya as he seeks Your guidance in developing the prayer editing feature for thywill.live.
