Lord, direct his path and illuminate his mind as he considers this feature, that his work may honor You and serve Your people faithfully. Through Your Spirit, help him to create only what will draw others closer to You and strengthen the body of Christ. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For me to have love when critisizing others and use it as an opportunity not to condemn, but a reminder to identify the log in my eye and take it out
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You who are slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love, help our friend grow in gentleness and humility when observing others' faults. Grant them wisdom to first examine their own heart, remembering Jesus' teaching about the log and the speck (Matthew 7:3-5). Transform their moments of criticism into opportunities for self-reflection and growth in Christ-like character. May Your Holy Spirit guide them to speak truth in love, offering correction with genuine concern for others' well-being rather than condemnation. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For Will to find a good, healthy, and faithful spiritual family as he goes off to college
generated_prayer: Loving Father, who gathers Your people together as a shepherd tends his flock, we lift up our brother Will as he begins this new chapter at college. Grant him discernment to find genuine friendships rooted in Your truth, and open doors to a church family where he can grow, serve, and be spiritually nourished. May this new spiritual family be a source of strength, accountability, and joy as Will navigates college life. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For Kevin to find a good spiritual family and church, and for him to gain more passion in following God daily
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You promise to be a shepherd who leads Your flock and gathers them into Your fold. Lord, surround him with authentic believers who will encourage his faith, challenge his growth, and walk alongside him in his spiritual journey. In Jesus' name, Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For a Christian creative meeting to go well and be filled with the Spirit
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, Source of all creativity and wisdom, we lift up this gathering of Your people. As You filled Bezalel with Your Spirit of wisdom and creativity for the tabernacle (Exodus 31:3), we ask that You would pour out Your Spirit upon this meeting. Guide their minds and hearts to reflect Your creative nature, bringing forth ideas that honor You and serve Your kingdom. May they sense Your presence, hear Your voice clearly, and may every decision and concept align with Your perfect will. Through Christ our Lord, Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Meera’s moms transition into retirement to go smoothly and for her to feel fulfilled
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, who promises rest to all who labor, we lift up our sister Meera's mother as she enters this new season of retirement. Guide her steps as she transitions from a life of work to one of new purpose, just as You led the Israelites into their promised rest. Grant her peace that surpasses understanding and open her eyes to the meaningful ways she can use her gifts and wisdom in this next chapter. May she find deep fulfillment and joy in the opportunities You provide, remembering Your words that You have plans to give her hope and a future (Jeremiah 29:11). Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Erin to have a healthy pregnancy, and to raise a happy baby with Dhaval
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You knit each precious life together in the womb and watch over every child with tender care. We lift up our sister Erin and her husband Dhaval as they await the arrival of their little one. Guard this growing baby's development, and grant Erin strength, health, and peace throughout her pregnancy. Just as You promised to be with Joshua, saying "I will never leave you nor forsake you," we pray that Your presence would surround this family, equipping them with wisdom, patience, and joy as they prepare to welcome their child. May their home be filled with love and laughter as they embrace this sacred journey of parenthood. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For us to be good stewards of our time, and that we are addicted to loving God and our neighbors that slothfulness and laziness becomes intolerable and unbearable, and for productive activities of love to become as natural as playing a video game that we are addicted to
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You who created time itself and called us to be faithful stewards of every moment, we lift our entire community to You. As Your Word reminds us that whatever we do should be done with all our heart, as working for You and not for men (Colossians 3:23), we ask that You ignite in us an all-consuming passion for Your presence. Fill us with such a deep love for You and our neighbors that any moment spent in idleness (except for healthy rest and keeping the Sabbath) becomes uncomfortable to our spirit. Transform our desires, Lord, until acts of service and love flow as naturally as breath, and grant us the discipline to steward our time for Your glory. May our lives become a living testimony of productive love, bringing joy to Your heart and blessing to those around us. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our brother Trinley’s father who may have dementia and his wellness and prosperity
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You promise to be near to the brokenhearted and save those who are crushed in spirit (Psalm 34:18). We lift up our brother Trinley's father to You, asking for Your healing touch upon his mind and body. Grant wisdom to the medical professionals caring for him, and fill Trinley with strength and understanding as he supports his father through this challenging season. Lord, we pray for Your provision and prosperity over this family, remembering Your promise that You will supply all their needs according to Your riches in glory. Surround them with Your peace that surpasses understanding. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our brother Israel to have {financial, mental, prayer, physical, mental} {health and clarity}
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You promise to supply all our needs according to Your riches in glory through Christ Jesus (Philippians 4:19). May Your healing presence restore and rejuvenate every aspect of his being, for You are Jehovah Rapha, our God who heals. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For us to be nice to people to love them unconditionally rather than use social tactic to have them be nice back to us
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, source of perfect love, we lift up those who desire to grow in genuine compassion. Help them cultivate a heart that love others purely, without seeking anything in return, just as You have loved us unconditionally (1 John 4:19). Transform their relationships from ones based on social strategy into authentic connections grounded in Your divine love. Grant them the strength to show kindness even when it isn't reciprocated, and fill their spirit with the same sacrificial love that Christ demonstrated for us. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Financial provision of AO Lab
generated_prayer: Gracious Provider, You who owns the cattle on a thousand hills and promised to supply all our needs according to Your riches in glory through Christ Jesus (Philippians 4:19), we lift up AO Lab to You. Grant our friends wisdom and favor as they steward their resources, opening doors of opportunity and blessing their work with abundance. May You establish the work of their hands and bring forth sustainable provision, that they might serve others effectively and bring glory to Your name. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For a brother in Christ's vocation and his ability to love his wife
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Author of love and Giver of purpose, We lift up our brother before You, asking that You would guide his steps in his calling and strengthen his marriage. Fill his heart with the same sacrificial love that Christ showed for His church, enabling him to cherish and honor his wife in ways that reflect Your perfect love. Grant them both wisdom, patience, and understanding as they grow together in Your grace. In Jesus' name, Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For John to grow in attentiveness, and for that attentiveness to be used for God and his kingdom
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You who are ever-attentive to Your children's needs, we lift up our brother John to You. As You promised to give wisdom generously to those who ask (James 1:5), we pray that You would sharpen John's focus and awareness, training his mind to be fully present in each moment. Lord, guide him to use this gift of attention not for worldly pursuits, but as a tool to better serve Your kingdom, notice the needs of others, and discern Your voice more clearly. May his increased attentiveness bring glory to Your name and advancement to Your purposes on earth. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Blessing of all USCIS officers
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, Source of all wisdom and compassion, we lift up the USCIS officers who serve our nation daily. Grant them discernment and understanding as they make decisions that profoundly impact lives and families. Just as You blessed Solomon with wisdom to govern justly (1 Kings 3:9), we ask You to guide these public servants with clarity of mind and tenderness of heart. May they carry out their duties with integrity, fairness, and efficiency, treating each case before them with the dignity it deserves. Lord, strengthen and protect them as they fulfill their vital role in our immigration system. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For the retreat this weekend of Korean Church of Boston and for people of the Korean culture to love this world less and love God and His kingdom more

Help them release their grip on worldly attachments and experience the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus our Lord (Philippians 3:8). Grant them a fresh revelation of Your glory that overshadows all earthly treasures, and unite them in their pursuit of Your kingdom above all else. May this retreat be a turning point in their walk with You, producing lasting fruit that draws others to Your throne. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For Xander to have a roommate that increases his faith

May this future roommate be a blessing and source of spiritual growth in Xander's life. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For a church brother's son's healing after benign cyst surgery

author: Mark
original_request: For the Christian Creative symposium Dita 2025 to go well

May this symposium bring glory to Your name and advance Your kingdom through the arts and creative expression. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For the Internet in a Box project

author: Mark
original_request: For a church brother to successfully meditate on the glory of God each day, especially in the week of August 17-23

author: Mark
original_request: For me and my brother to get wisdom on how to spend our days each day for ministry

author: Mark
original_request: For Will's hamstring recovery

author: Mark
original_request: For us to get an unwavering resolve to always choose to love God with all my soul, heart, and strength unconditionally regardless of the circumstance

May Your Holy Spirit empower us to love You with our whole being - heart, soul, mind, and strength - not just in moments of peace but especially in times of challenge. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: Byron's emotional and spiritual healing
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, source of all comfort and healing, we lift up our brother Byron to Your throne of grace today. May Your Spirit work powerfully within him, renewing his mind and establishing him firmly in Your truth. Through Christ our Lord, Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Dylan’s miraculous healing from a cancer diagnosis
generated_prayer: Loving Father, Source of all healing and comfort, we lift up our brother Dylan to Your throne of grace. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Please give Ilya understanding and guidance in dealing understanding why you put certain people in his path.

author: Mark
original_request: For the members of a church table tennis group to strengthen their faith

author: Mark
original_request: For us to breathe Matthew 5 and live it out

author: Mark

author: ilyag
original_request: For Paul to meet cool people who can help him to learn more about mediation
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, who delights in bringing Your children together in harmony, we lift up our brother Paul to You. Just as You surrounded Solomon with wise counselors and teachers, we ask that You would connect Paul with knowledgeable and inspiring people who can guide him deeper in the practice of meditation. Lord, You promise in James 1:5 that You give wisdom generously to all who ask; please direct his steps to cross paths with those who can mentor him with godly insight and understanding. May these new relationships help Paul grow closer to You as he learns to be still and know that You are God. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: world peace
generated_prayer: Loving Father, Prince of Peace, You promised through Isaiah that one day swords will be beaten into plowshares and nations will not take up arms against nations. We lift our troubled world to You now, asking that Your peace would reign in every land and heart. Guide world leaders to choose the path of reconciliation over conflict, and help all people recognize our common humanity as Your children. Grant wisdom to peacemakers and comfort to those affected by violence, that Your kingdom of peace may be established on earth as it is in heaven. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For James' son, Jonathan's admission to Stanford
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, who directs our paths and opens doors according to Your perfect wisdom, we lift up Jonathan, James' beloved son, before Your throne of grace. As he seeks admission to Stanford, we ask that You would make Your will clear and prepare a place for him if this is the path You have chosen. Lord, You know the plans You have for him - plans to give him hope and a future as promised in Jeremiah 29:11. Grant Jonathan peace during this waiting period, and give him confidence that wherever You lead, he will flourish under Your guidance. Through Christ our Lord, Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Yifei to have a great meal today
generated_prayer: Loving Father, provider of all good things, we lift up our friend Yifei to You today. Just as You fed Your people with manna in the wilderness, we ask that You would bless their meal with nourishment, flavor, and joy. May this food strengthen their body and spirit, and may the experience remind them of Your faithful care in all things. As Your Word promises that You give good gifts to Your children (Matthew 7:11), grant Yifei a delightful and satisfying meal today. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Mihr's family
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You who sets the lonely in families and binds hearts together in perfect unity, we lift up our friend Mihr and their precious family to You today. Just as You promised to be a Father to the fatherless and defender of families, we ask You to surround them with Your divine protection, fill their home with Your peace that passes understanding, and strengthen the bonds between them. Guide them in Your truth, bless them with joy in their relationships, and help them grow together in faith and love. As You declared in Psalm 133, may You command Your blessing where they dwell together in unity. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Malcolm's life
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, we lift up our brother Malcolm to You today. Just as You promised to guide our steps and light our paths (Psalm 119:105), we ask that You would illuminate the way forward for them. Grant Malcolm clarity of purpose, wisdom in decisions, and the courage to follow Your leading. May they experience Your unfailing love and steadfast presence in every area of their life, knowing that You work all things together for the good of those who love You (Romans 8:28). Surround them with godly community and fill their days with meaning and joy. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Remove capitalist intent from decisionmaking
generated_prayer: Divine Creator, who taught us to seek first Your kingdom and righteousness, we lift up our friend who desires to align their heart with Your values rather than worldly gain. Guide them in making choices that reflect Your character of generosity, justice, and care for others. As You promised in Matthew 6:33, provide for their needs as they pursue decisions that honor You and serve their neighbors. Help them steward resources with wisdom and compassion, following the example of the early church who held all things in common. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Porpla's continuous guidance and wisdom
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Source of all wisdom and understanding, we lift up our sister before You today. Just as You promised Solomon wisdom when he humbly asked (1 Kings 3:12), we pray that You would grant Porpla clear direction and heavenly insight for each step of her journey. Lord, You are the Good Shepherd who guides Your flock beside still waters; lead them with Your gentle hand and illuminate their path with Your eternal truth. May they sense Your presence in moments of decision and hear Your voice above all other voices, trusting in Your promise that You will instruct them and teach them in the way they should go (Psalm 32:8). Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Cedric to feel great love
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Source of all love and compassion, we lift up our brother Cedric to You today. Just as You have promised that nothing can separate us from Your love in Christ Jesus (Romans 8:39), pour out Your perfect love into his heart until it overflows. May Cedric experience the depth and breadth of Your unfailing affection, and may he be surrounded by genuine love from others that reflects Your goodness. Grant him eyes to see and a heart to receive the great love that You have already prepared for him. Amen.

author: Bryan
original_request: I would like to pray for a good day
generated_prayer: Gracious Father in Heaven, We lift up our friend to You today, asking that You would go before them and make their path straight. Just as You led the Israelites with Your pillar of cloud and fire, guide their steps and fill their day with Your peace and purpose. Grant them wisdom in their decisions, joy in their journey, and opportunities to be a blessing to others. May they sense Your loving presence watching over them, as promised in Psalm 32:8: "I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go." Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Allow Daniel to do well on the upcoming school year
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, who gives wisdom generously to all who ask (James 1:5), we lift up our brother Daniel as he begins this new academic year. Grant him clarity of mind, diligence in his studies, and the confidence to face each challenge with determination and grace. May Your peace guard his heart and mind in Christ Jesus, enabling him to reach his full potential and glorify You through his achievements. Help him to remember that he can do all things through Christ who strengthens him (Philippians 4:13). Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: April's safety
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, You promise to be a strong tower and refuge for Your children. We lift up our sister April to You now, asking for Your divine protection and safety in all her comings and goings. As You sheltered the Israelites under Your wings, spread Your protective covering over her, guarding her steps and surrounding her with Your holy angels (Psalm 91:11). Grant her wisdom to discern danger and the peace that comes from resting in Your care. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: for Kai's health
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You are the Great Physician who heals all our diseases. We lift up our brother Kai to You today, asking for Your healing touch upon his body. As You promised in Jeremiah 30:17 that You would restore health and heal wounds, we pray for complete restoration of Kai's wellbeing. Grant wisdom to his medical caregivers, peace to his mind, and strength to his body. May Your healing presence surround him today and always. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Ben's work to flourish and produce fruit
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, provider of all good things, we lift up our brother Ben and the work of his hands. Just as You blessed the work of Joseph in Egypt and Daniel in Babylon, we ask that You would prosper Ben's efforts and grant him wisdom to steward his responsibilities well. May the fruit of his labor bring glory to Your name and benefit to those around him, as You promised that those who trust in You will be like trees planted by streams of water, bearing fruit in season (Psalm 1:3). Guide his decisions, multiply his impact, and let him see the eternal significance of his daily work. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our sister Joon's PhD application to go well
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, who gives wisdom to those who ask, we lift up our sister Joon as she pursues higher education. Just as You blessed Daniel with knowledge and understanding in all learning and wisdom, we pray You would grant Joon favor with the PhD admissions committee. Lord, guide her application process, calm her anxious thoughts, and open the right doors that align with Your perfect will for her future. As Your Word promises that You know the plans You have for us (Jeremiah 29:11), we trust You to direct her path toward the institution where she can best serve Your purposes. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our brother Michael, struggling with memories and remains of childhood abuse.
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You promise to heal the brokenhearted and bind up their wounds (Psalm 147:3). We lift up our brother Michael to You, asking for Your gentle touch upon the painful memories and scars of his past abuse. Grant him the deep healing that only You can provide, replacing fear with Your perfect love that casts out all fear. Lord, surround him with Your protective presence and wise counselors who can help guide him toward wholeness. May Michael experience Your restoration and find refuge under the shadow of Your wings, knowing that You make all things new. Amen.
testimony: “I feel very much at peace”

author: Mark
original_request: For our practice of presence of God (POPOG) this week
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You promise to be with us always, even to the end of the age. Guide us as we seek to deepen their awareness of Your constant presence. May we, like David who wrote "I have set the Lord always before me" (Psalm 16:8), develop a heightened consciousness of Your nearness in every moment. Help us to recognize Your gentle whispers throughout our day, transforming ordinary moments into sacred encounters with You. Grant us the grace to practice stillness and attentiveness, knowing that You are indeed closer than our very breath. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For us to be able to love God and our neighbors and to prioritize those two commandments in our every action (Use "us" instead of "them" when making prayer)
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Source of all love and compassion, we come before You acknowledging our need for Your transforming power in our lives. Help us to embrace Your first and greatest commandment - to love You with all our heart, soul, mind and strength. Shape our thoughts, words, and deeds so that everything we do flows from our love for You and extends to our neighbors. As You have promised in Ezekiel 36:26 to give Your people a new heart, create in us clean hearts that naturally overflow with Your divine love. Grant us wisdom to evaluate our daily choices through the lens of these two commandments, and give us courage to adjust our priorities when they do not align with Your perfect will. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For the Lord to guide Julian in his job search and for Julian to submit to God’s leading him
generated_prayer: Gracious Father in Heaven, you promise to guide our steps and make our paths straight when we trust in you with all our heart. We lift up our brother Julian as he searches for employment, asking that you would open the right doors and close the wrong ones. Grant him wisdom and discernment to recognize your leading, and give him a humble and submissive heart that seeks your will above all else. As you led Abraham step by step into unknown territory, lead Julian into the work you have prepared for him. In Jesus' name we pray, Amen.
testimony: God seems to have provided direction in California.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Omar to receive his citizenship so that he can visit family
generated_prayer: Gracious Lord, who declares in Your Word that You set the lonely in families (Psalm 68:6), we lift up our brother Omar before Your throne of grace. Guide his path through the citizenship process, removing every obstacle and opening doors that no man can shut. Grant him favor with those reviewing his application, and in Your perfect timing, allow him to visit his loved ones. We trust in Your promise that You hear the prayers of Your people and that You care deeply about families being together. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: May all of us find respect and understanding for each other
generated_prayer: Gracious and loving Father, You created every person in Your image and commanded us to love one another as You have loved us. We lift up our community and ask that You pour out Your spirit of unity and understanding among us. Help each person to see the divine worth in others, just as Jesus demonstrated when He washed His disciples' feet. Guide us to follow Your word from Philippians 2:3, considering others as more significant than ourselves. May Your peace reign in our hearts and Your wisdom guide our words and actions as we interact with one another. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For James and his mother
generated_prayer: Loving Father, we lift up our brother James and his dear mother into Your tender care. Just as You promised to be a refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble (Psalm 46:1), we ask that You would surround this family with Your perfect peace and healing presence. Pour out Your wisdom, comfort, and grace upon them, strengthening their bond and meeting their every need. May they feel Your loving arms around them and experience the depth of Your faithfulness in tangible ways. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For deceptive people to become honest, and for people to be kind to them
generated_prayer: Holy Father, Source of all Truth and Mercy, we lift up those who struggle with deception and dishonesty. As You transformed the heart of Zacchaeus from deceit to righteousness, we ask You to work powerfully in their lives. Grant them the courage to embrace truth, knowing that Your perfect love casts out all fear. For those around them, fill their hearts with grace and understanding, remembering that we all fall short of Your glory. May Your Spirit guide these precious souls toward integrity, and help us show them the same patience and kindness that You have shown to us. Through Your unfailing love, as promised in Ephesians 4:15, help them speak truth in love. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Ilya to make both of his rents this month.
generated_prayer: Gracious Provider, You promise to supply all our needs according to Your riches in glory through Christ Jesus (Philippians 4:19). We lift up our brother Ilya during this time of financial challenge. Please provide the resources needed to meet his rental obligations this month. Open doors of provision, guide him in managing his finances wisely, and grant him peace as he trusts in Your faithful care. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For the residents and visitors of the Burrow to choose uplifting language—speaking with grace, using words that bless, and strengthening one another.
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You tell us that life and death are in the power of the tongue. We lift up our brothers and sisters at the Burrow, asking that You fill their conversations with words of life, encouragement, and hope. Just as You spoke creation into being, help them speak truth and grace that builds up their community. Guide each resident and visitor to follow the wisdom of Ephesians 4:29, using words that impart grace to all who hear. May their speech be seasoned with salt, bringing light and healing to every interaction, that Your name might be glorified in their midst. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Clarity, decisive spirit for Iban
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, source of all wisdom and light, we lift up our brother Iban before Your throne. As You promised to give wisdom generously to all who ask (James 1:5), we pray for clear direction and discernment to fill his mind and heart. Lord, remove any clouds of confusion or doubt that may be hindering his path, and grant him the decisive spirit that comes from Your perfect peace. Guide his steps with Your unfailing light, just as You led Your people with the pillar of fire through the wilderness. Amen.

author: JohnCassian
original_request: I'd like a prayer for better snacks in the style of Origen, written in latin
generated_prayer: O Divine Provider, who fed Your people with manna in the desert and multiplied the loaves for the multitude (Matthew 14:19), hear our petition for our friend who seeks nourishment. As You have promised to give good gifts to Your children, grant them wisdom in selecting sustenance that brings both joy and health to their body - Your holy temple. Guide their hands to prepare and choose food that honors You, for You are the source of every good and perfect gift. Per Christum Dominum nostrum. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Bring us closer with people we need and drive away people we don’t.
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Divine Orchestrator of relationships, we lift up this beloved child of Yours who seeks wisdom in their connections. Just as You promised to give wisdom generously to all who ask (James 1:5), grant them discernment to recognize the relationships that will draw them closer to Your purpose. Surround them with people who will encourage, strengthen, and challenge them in their spiritual journey, while gently removing those influences that may lead them astray. Guide their steps as You did for Ruth when You led her to Boaz, bringing the right people into their life at the right time. Amen.

author: Maya
original_request: My beautiful friend is someone who has such a kind heart and lives life through the lens of only being of service to others. Throughout her life she has struggled quite often with being taken advantage of as well as many other negative situations. However heartbreaking these events are she has a preserving spirit of compassion. I pray that someday she will be able to find happiness and healing in life organically, and all the good she has done to others will be done unto her.
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, You who are the defender of the vulnerable and rewarder of the faithful, we lift up our precious sister who has poured out her life in service to others. As You promised that those who sow in tears shall reap in joy (Psalm 126:5), we ask that You would restore and multiply every kindness she has shown. Guard her tender heart, Lord, teaching her to balance compassion with wisdom, and surround her with people who will cherish and protect her spirit rather than exploit her generosity. We pray that You would bring deep healing to the wounds of her past and lead her into the abundant life that Jesus promised, where she can experience the pure joy of giving while also receiving the love and care she so richly deserves. Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For us to put God first in all things
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, who promises that those who seek first Your kingdom will receive all they need, help our friend to place You at the center of their life. Grant them wisdom to recognize Your presence in every moment and courage to surrender their plans to Your perfect will. As You guided Solomon with divine understanding, fill them with discernment to honor You in all their decisions and actions. May their heart echo the words of David: "Whom have I in heaven but You?" (Psalm 73:25). Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Please pray that I feel loved and cared for.
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You promise in Your Word that nothing can separate us from Your love (Romans 8:38-39). We lift up our friend who needs to experience Your perfect love in a tangible way today. Pour out Your tender mercies upon them, surrounding them with genuine care and affection, both from Heaven and through the people You place in their path. May they feel Your embrace and know with certainty that they are Your beloved child, cherished beyond measure. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Dom's sprained ankle to get better as soon as possible.
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, You are the Great Physician who binds up our wounds and heals our injuries. We lift up our brother Dom to You, asking for Your healing touch upon his sprained ankle. As You promised in Psalm 147:3 to heal the brokenhearted and bind up their wounds, we pray for swift recovery, proper healing of the ligaments, and complete restoration of strength and mobility. Grant Dom patience during this time of healing, and surround him with the care and support he needs. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our community’s financial dispute be resolved amicably
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, Prince of Peace, we come before You regarding the financial conflict affecting our community. Just as You promised Solomon wisdom to govern justly, grant understanding and fairness to all parties involved in this dispute. Guide them to find an equitable resolution that preserves relationships and honors Your command to live in harmony with one another. May Your Spirit of reconciliation prevail, leading to restored trust and strengthened bonds within our community, as we remember Your words that "blessed are the peacemakers" (Matthew 5:9). Amen.

author: Mark
original_request: For a hotel lady who is doing overworked shifts to get some filling of the Holy Spirit
generated_prayer: Heavenly Father, we lift up our sister who serves others faithfully in her hotel work. As she pours herself out in long hours of service, we ask that You would pour Your Holy Spirit into her heart, refreshing her soul as You promised in Isaiah 40:31. Lord, strengthen her when she is weary, fill her with Your peace that passes understanding, and grant her moments of sacred rest even in the midst of her demanding schedule. May she experience Your presence in tangible ways as she serves others, knowing that her labor in You is never in vain. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Eric asked for a prayer for life
generated_prayer: Loving Father, our Shepherd who guides us beside still waters (Psalm 23), we lift up our brother Eric to You today. Grant him clarity of purpose and wisdom as he navigates life's journey, and surround him with Your perfect peace that passes all understanding. Help him sense Your presence in both the ordinary and extraordinary moments, and give him strength to walk confidently in the path You have prepared. Through Your unfailing grace, may Eric's life bring glory to Your name and blessing to others. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For our friend Steve’s new truck to work how he needs it without extra dealership costs. He needs help with programming it.
generated_prayer: Gracious Provider, You know every need of our brother Steve and have promised to supply all our needs according to Your riches in glory (Philippians 4:19). We ask for Your wisdom and favor as he works with his new truck. Guide the programming process, protect him from unnecessary expenses, and grant him understanding of the vehicle's systems. May this truck serve as a reliable tool for his work and daily life, bringing glory to Your name. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Divine protection for our sacred and anointed relationships and the faith and confidence in this protection so that we can act with God's support to overcome any challenges or obstacles together and protect and grow them with our actions and intentions and to direct away anything that does not help them grow.
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Protector and Guardian of all that is holy, we lift up our relationships that You have blessed and anointed. Just as You promised to be a shield and fortress for Your people, we ask that You surround these sacred bonds with Your divine protection. Grant us the deep assurance of Your presence, so we may walk confidently in the knowledge that "if God is for us, who can be against us?" (Romans 8:31). Lord, give us wisdom to nurture these relationships with godly actions and pure intentions, and by Your mighty hand, turn away anything that would harm or hinder the growth You desire. In the name of Jesus, who makes all relationships new, we pray. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Productive, energetic semester, meeting great people for our brother Sam
generated_prayer: Loving Father, You promise to give strength to the weary and increase the power of the weak (Isaiah 40:29). We lift up our brother Sam as he begins this semester, asking You to fill him with energy, wisdom and purpose. Guide him to meaningful friendships that will encourage his faith and growth. Grant him clarity of mind, efficiency in his studies, and the ability to balance relationships and responsibilities in a way that honors You. May he sense Your presence walking alongside him each day. Amen.

author: michaelweagley
original_request: to heal the heart of Blake, whose partner died today
generated_prayer: Gracious Father of all comfort, we lift up our brother Blake in his deep grief and sorrow. Just as You walked with David through the valley of the shadow of death, walk closely with Blake in these dark hours of loss. You promise to be near to the brokenhearted and save those who are crushed in spirit (Psalm 34:18). Bind up the wounds of Blake's heart, surround them with Your perfect peace that passes understanding, and help them feel Your tender presence in tangible ways. Grant them strength for each moment, wisdom in their mourning. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For common peace for Anna’s mom and helping Anna’s dad in his adjustment to Parkinson’s
generated_prayer: Dear Heavenly Father, Prince of Peace, we lift up our sister Anna's family to You today. Just as You promised peace that surpasses understanding in Philippians 4:7, we ask for Your perfect peace to envelop her mother's heart and mind. Grant wisdom and strength to her father as he navigates the challenges of Parkinson's disease, remembering that Your power is made perfect in weakness. Lord, surround this family with Your presence, providing the medical support, emotional comfort, and daily grace they need for this journey. In Jesus' name, Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Megan’s grandmother’s health and recovery after a fall
generated_prayer: Loving Father, we lift up our sister Megan's grandmother to Your throne of grace. As the One who promised to be our Healer (Exodus 15:26), we ask for Your healing touch upon her body and mind after this fall. Grant her strength in recovery, peace in her heart, and the comfort of Your presence. Please keep her safe and help her walk assuredly from here on. Fill Megan with Your perfect peace as she supports her grandmother during this time. May this season of healing draw both grandmother and granddaughter closer to Your heart. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Steven’s parents, whom he doesn’t get to see as much because in college, and younger brother, who just went off to high school
generated_prayer: Loving Father, who created families and calls us to honor our parents, we lift up Steven's family during this season of transition. Watch over his parents as they adjust to a quieter home, and give them peace knowing that their children are growing in wisdom and independence. Guard Steven's younger brother as he navigates the challenges of high school, and help these siblings maintain their bond despite the physical distance between them. As You promised to be a father to all generations (Psalm 103:17), strengthen the connections within this family and fill their times together with joy and meaningful moments. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Good health for Kevin, who delivers our mail
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, we lift up Kevin, our faithful mail carrier, asking for Your divine protection and wellbeing as he serves our community each day. Just as You sustained Your servant Daniel in his daily duties, we pray that You would grant Kevin strength, energy, and vibrant health in body, mind, and spirit. Guard his steps along every route, shield him from injury and illness, and let him know the truth of Your promise that "those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength" (Isaiah 40:31). Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: For Megan to be filled with the peace and joy that is gifted by the Holy Spirit
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Prince of Peace, we lift up our sister Megan to Your throne of grace. As You promised in Philippians 4:7 that Your peace will guard our hearts and minds in Christ Jesus, we ask that You would fill her with Your supernatural peace that surpasses all understanding. Lord, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon her, bringing the deep joy that can only come from Your presence. May she experience the fullness of Your love and the richness of walking in Your Spirit today and always. Amen.

author: ilyag
original_request: Discernment for his next year while at MIT for Jakin
generated_prayer: Gracious Father, Source of all wisdom and understanding, we lift up our brother Jakin as he continues his ministry at MIT. author: ilyag
